==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
There is an app that lets humans create gods. The god that are created using the app start weak. Each god is born with one special power of their creator's choosing.

Gods are born either resembling living statues or babies with odd colored hair. Society is built around the idea of each person building their own god to help them. I don't like the idea of having to wait for my god to become more powerful overtime.

In order to get around having to wait, I make my god's power the ability to draw power from their future self. This allows for my god to shift in age quickly for short bursts of divine power. My idea seems clever, but I wake up before I really understand it's practicality.
